info.title: dotmet
info.description: Deterministic .NET code analysis and review tooling for structured JSON feedback.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyzes the resolved target and writes an AnalysisReport JSON. Use current-only mode for inventory and Git mode for change-aware review. Exit code 0 is process success, not a clean pass; read JSON verdict and completeness.

options.name: --solutionPath
options.description: Solution target: .sln or .slnx file inside --repositoryRoot. Mutually exclusive with --projectPath. Omit both target options to auto-discover one target. [Default: null]

options.name: --projectPath
options.description: Project target inside --repositoryRoot: .csproj file, .NET directory with one .sln/.slnx or .csproj, Unity project directory, or Godot project directory. Mutually exclusive with --solutionPath. [Default: null]

options.name: --targetSet
options.description: Target set JSON file inside --repositoryRoot. Mutually exclusive with --solutionPath, --projectPath, and explicit --targetKind values. Omit target options to use .dotmet/targets.json when present. [Default: null]

options.name: --targetKind
options.description: Allowed: auto, dotnet, unity, godot. auto detects the adapter from the resolved target; explicit values limit adapter selection to that kind. [Default: Auto]

options.name: --rulesPath
options.description: Rules JSON file path inside --repositoryRoot. Omit to use .dotmet/rules.json or built-in defaults; invalid explicit or discovered rules do not fall back. [Default: null]

options.name: --repositoryRoot
options.description: Existing repository root directory. Omit to resolve from the selected target and current working directory. Relative report paths and repository-relative filters use this root. [Default: null]

options.name: --comparisonMode
options.description: Allowed: none, git. none runs current-only inventory; git requires --comparisonBase and adds change-aware review signals when that explicit base can be evaluated. [Default: None]

options.name: --comparisonBase
options.description: Local Git revision used as the before source. Valid only with --comparisonMode git; dotmet does not fetch or mutate refs. [Default: null]

options.name: --cacheMode
options.description: Allowed: off, read, write, readWrite. Default readWrite allows both cache reads and writes. Cache state is audit context and does not change verdict semantics. [Default: ReadWrite]

options.name: --restoreMode
options.description: Allowed: auto, none. auto runs dotnet restore for .NET targets before workspace loading; none disables restore and reports missing assets. [Default: Auto]

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Alias for --restoreMode none.

options.name: --outputPath
options.description: Output file path. Omit to write JSON to standard output. Relative paths use the current working directory; parent directories are created and existing files are replaced. [Default: null]

options.name: --changeScope
options.description: Allowed: all, changed, introduced. Omit to include all findings. changed and introduced require an effective Git comparison with changes. [Default: null]

options.name: --minReviewPriority
options.description: Allowed: low, medium, high, critical. Hides lower-priority visible items but does not change analysis scope or unfiltered counts. [Default: null]

options.name: --category
options.description: Allowed: dependency-policy, cycle, complexity, public-surface, completeness. Repeated or comma-separated values are allowed. [Default: null]

options.name: --ruleId
options.description: Rule-id code filter from dotmet codes list, such as METRIC_CYCLOMATIC_COMPLEXITY. Repeated or comma-separated values are allowed. [Default: null]

options.name: --verdictImpact
options.description: Allowed: fail, warn, none. Repeated or comma-separated values are allowed. Hidden fail-impact findings remain counted in execution.filters. [Default: null]

options.name: --pathPrefix
options.description: Review-view repository-relative path prefix using '/' separators, such as src/. Does not narrow analysis, restore, target scope, or unfiltered counts. Repeated or comma-separated values are allowed. [Default: null]

options.name: --maxFindings
options.description: Non-negative maximum visible finding count after deterministic sorting. 0 is allowed. Omitted counts remain in execution.filters. [Default: null]

options.name: --maxSymbolResults
options.description: Non-negative maximum visible symbol result count after deterministic sorting. 0 is allowed. Omitted counts remain in execution.filters. [Default: null]

options.name: --maxReviewTargets
options.description: Non-negative maximum visible top review target count after deterministic sorting. 0 is allowed. Omitted counts remain in execution.filters. [Default: null]

options.name: --pretty
options.description: Write indented JSON. Omit to write compact JSON.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Describes one machine-readable code, including where it may appear and how it affects verdict interpretation, as CodeDescription JSON.

options.name: --pretty
options.description: Write indented JSON. Omit to write compact JSON.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists reserved machine-readable codes, their JSON locations, and verdict semantics as CodesCatalog JSON.

options.name: --pretty
options.description: Write indented JSON. Omit to write compact JSON.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Writes a repository-independent rules document skeleton. Allowed kind values are template and standard.

options.description: Allowed: template, standard. template writes an empty editing skeleton; standard writes dotmet.standard@1 thresholds explicitly. [Default: Template]
